population.span: Eligibility required an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of ≥20 to <45 ml/minute/1.73m 2 ; or ≥45 to <90 ml/minute/1.73m 2 with a urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (ACR) of ≥200 mg/g.

analysis_set.span: All analyses were performed according to the intention-to-treat principle and included data from all randomized participants including information collected between the formal interim analysis and final follow-up visits.

treatment_strategy.span: were randomly allocated to receive empagliflozin (10 mg once daily) or matching placebo using minimized randomization with a 10% stochastic element.

follow_up.span: Follow-up was completed on July 05 2022, at which time median follow-up was 2.0 years (interquartile range, 1.5 to 2.4 years).

entry_population_matches_question.why: The trial enrolled adults meeting CKD entry criteria, within the question's adult CKD population.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Adults with a race-adjusted CKD-EPI 16 eGFR of at least 20 but less than 45 ml per minute per 1.73 m 2 of body-surface area (irrespective of level of albuminuria)

notes: The served numbers match the amputation HR. Table 2 labels the column 'Hazard ratio (95% CI)'. The served_outcome estimand RR conflicts with the reported HR; no RR was inferred. Amputation is a safety outcome, not the primary cardiorenal composite requested by the broader question. All spans use held full text.
